title: vanilla+choco chips
body: This modpack is basically just vanilla, but with sum chocolate chips, if you know what i mean!! Basically, just some performace mods, qol mods, and very cool mods + resourcepacks! Just made for a better vanilla enviornment and better looking mc, so it is not recomended for weak systems, as some of these mods/resourcepacks will DESTROYY your pc! HUGEEE thanks to Dosya for Visual Effects + !!! This resource pack is basically shaders, but a resource pack! This pack wouldn't look as good without his amazing work (and why its only 1.21.5, but can you blame the man, the pack look SICKKKKK)!!! Thank yall if you donwload, i wont be cashing out, unless it generates some serious money, but THANK YOU GUYSS, HAVE A GOOD ONE, LOVE YALL <3
